newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president orders probe into Hanbo.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president orders probe into Hanbo.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Monday ordered a probe into the Hanbo Group after the financial collapse of its Hanbo Steel & General Construction Co unit, a presidential spokesman said.
Opposition politicians have accused the government of irregularities over huge loans to Hanbo Group, the country's 14th-biggest industrial conglomerate.
"In a meeting with Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung, President Kim ordered the government to carry out a thorough investigation into the Hanbo Group," a spokesman said by telephone.

Hanbo Steel, the group's flagship, has defaulted on debt and is seeking court protection with three other group units. Hanbo's top executives, including founder Chung Tae-soo, have been barred from leaving the country.
The finance ministry says Hanbo borrowed about five trillion won ($5.8 billion) from banks and financial institutions against its net worth of 224.3 billion won.
The opposition National Congress for New Politics has alleged that political pressure was put on banks to continue lending to Hanbo despite its shaky financial status.
